title: Black Eagles Golden Deer Lower Weapons
prompt:

Youthful Black Eagles students with red-black sashes and Golden Deer students with yellow sashes lower padded weapons and training bows. Teachers and knights watch from the edge. The wide frame proves the mock battle involved all three houses, not just Blue Lions drills.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: ending whistle carries from Blue Lions line to backfield. Transition out: cut back to Felix/Byleth aftermath. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.
